summary: The down-zap path reaches dig.c:dighole on a magical trap. C rolls d(3,6), calls explode with TRAP_EXPLODE and EXPL_MAGICAL, then deletes the trap and redraws the map. The original JS branch recorded note_unported and skipped the blast; the correction now calls the existing js/explode.js helper with the source damage roll and preserves deletion/redraw order. The full 206-step recording matches.

source.branch: In dighole, after the too-hard guard, a magical trap triggers explode(dig_x,dig_y,0,20+d(3,6),TRAP_EXPLODE,EXPL_MAGICAL), then deltrap and newsym. The bounded correction implements that branch and does not claim the rest of dighole or the explode.c file.
callers: zap.c:weffects dispatches a digging wand or spell to zap_dig; zap.c:zap_dig calls dighole(FALSE,TRUE,NULL) for a downward zap when there are no stairs. js/zap.js:weffects -> zap_dig -> dighole already follows this path, so no caller edit is required.
dependencies: explode.c:explode is already available as js/explode.js:explode in the accepted base and handles TRAP_EXPLODE and EXPL_MAGICAL; this task only wires the existing helper from dighole.
